**Building the future of live entertainment** — you're not watching, you're
in it. Living worlds an audience helps shape, piloted into any place: a
venue, a live stream, a home.

Infinite Spaces is a marketplace for living worlds. Creators author participatory experiences in Playbox — worlds an audience helps shape — and run them live in venues, streams, and homes. A two-person crew produces what used to take a full production team.

How AI becomes a participant in a system, not a post-processing step. How you run inference inside a real-time constraint. How you design authoring surfaces where intent — not scripted logic — drives behavior. The difference between an AI feature and an AI-native architecture.

## What You'll Do

What you'll ship in your first 90 days: An AI participant in the live loop — inference running inside the real-time constraint, an intent-driven authoring surface where description (not scripted logic) drives behavior, wired into the World layer.

## What We're Looking For

- Inference systems — can optimize and deploy models into production pipelines where latency is a hard constraint, not an aspiration
- Agent architecture — has designed systems where multiple AI components hand off to each other; understands orchestration patterns, memory, tool use
- 3D / spatial ML fluency — Gaussian splatting, NeRF, or volumetric reconstruction is a strong differentiator (the dedicated owner of the volumetric pipeline is Role 6; this role orchestrates inference around it)
- Prompt design as system design — treats model inputs and outputs as interface contracts, not free-form experimentation
- Recognizes the difference between retrofitting AI onto a system and building a system that is AI-native from the ground up

Adjacent experience that signals: CUDA / GPU compute beyond inference, creative AI tooling (ControlNet, diffusion pipelines in production), streaming / frame-by-frame inference, multi-modal input processing

## Benefits

- Competitive Seattle salary and meaningful early equity
- Equity-heavy structures available before cash is fully in place, with an honest timeline to when salary normalizes
- Health, dental, and vision coverage
- A small team where everyone owns real surface area and your work ships

*You're not watching. You're in it.*
